description: Make contracts/ a language-neutral source of truth with generated Python AND TS bindings + a drift gate (docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md §10). The Python backend and the TS client both consume the canonical schema/registries; neither language is authoritative — a JSON/schema source generates both, mirroring the koine-contracts pattern already used for predicate-mapping.

userStories.title: Language-neutral contract source + generators
userStories.description: Establish the canonical schema/registries (canonical-schema.json, predicate-mapping.json, lexicon-mapping.json, confidence-rubric.json, capability-manifest.json) as the source of truth under contracts/, with codegen producing typed Python and TS bindings.
acceptanceCriteria: contracts/ holds the neutral source files; a codegen script emits Python types/loaders (for engine + services/api) and TS types (for web) from them.
The engine and services/api consume the generated Python bindings; web consumes the generated TS bindings; no side hand-maintains a divergent copy.
Generated outputs are reproducible (re-running codegen is a no-op on a clean tree).

userStories.title: Drift gate
userStories.description: A test fails if the committed generated bindings don't match a fresh generation from the source — the same drift-fails-CI discipline as the existing registry mirror.
acceptanceCriteria: A test regenerates from the contracts/ source and asserts byte-equality with the committed bindings (Python and TS).
The gate is wired into .chief/verify.sh so a contract change without regeneration blocks merge.
